context: M19 o5. 11th floor, Room 1112. Camera holds on Teddy's face and Odessa behind him. Nothing else is shown.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Mr. Hollis? It's Teddy. I'm coming in.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: His radio's still on. Shipping news. Ships leaving for everywhere.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Close his eyes, Mr. Arce. Then call somebody. Then come back and sit with me.
